note: Baseline for comparing GH Actions scheduling delay before/after the 2026-09-01 fixes. See commits 1e4ecabc (workflow consolidation) and 193e6d53 (pages-deploy skip-if-unchanged). Ask Claude to re-run the same measurement and diff against this file.
measurement_method: For schedule-triggered runs only, delay = minutes between the run's actual createdAt and the nearest preceding nominal cron slot for that workflow (tried day offsets -1/0/+1, took smallest non-negative delta).
how_to_recheck: gh run list --limit 150 --json databaseId,name,workflowName,conclusion,createdAt,event,status  # count Deploy Pages occurrences and total window coverage
gh run list --workflow=<wf> --json databaseId,conclusion,createdAt,event,status --limit 50  # per email workflow, recompute avg delay minutes
gh api /repos/MercMink21/clairvoyance-backend/actions/runs/<id>/jobs  # spot-check Deploy Pages runs for skipped conclusion on no-op steps
